name: Skyreach
description: Skyreach, drafted from the build spec's examples. The places, clock steps and starting locations are placeholders until the campaign notes (SR - Campaign Complete, the two narrator-only entries) fill them in.

effects.0: Peace, as far as anyone in Gilead can tell.
effects.1: Riders on the border roads; grain is dearer.
effects.2: The Skar crossings are watched; carters wait a day to pass.
effects.4: Levies are called in the Low Market; the young men are gone.
effects.5: Smoke on the horizon at night; refugees at the gates.
effects.6: The war is at Gilead's walls.

effects.1: Highwatch's lanterns burn late; messengers come and go.
effects.2: Highwatch has sent word to the Gilded Hand.
effects.3: Highwatch's banner flies over the Low Market.
effects.4: Highwatch rules Gilead in all but name.

blurb: Gilead waits on news from the crossings.
